description: The only allowed status values anywhere in the archive. Honest statuses: nothing is ever marked tested, simulated, or manufactured without evidence.

descriptions.PROTOTYPE: A physical prototype was actually built.
descriptions.SIMULATED: A simulation was actually run and recorded — never assumed.
descriptions.SPECIFIED: Fully specified concept design (the normal archived state).
descriptions.TESTED: Physical testing was actually performed with evidence.

MEDICAL_SAFETY.description: Medical-family outputs are speculative wellness concepts only — not medical advice, not a diagnosis or treatment. MEDICAL_VALIDATION: NONE unless evidence exists.

descriptions.NONE: No physical prototype or test exists (the normal case).
descriptions.TESTED: Physical testing was performed with recorded evidence.

descriptions.DERIVED: Derived from another archived output (parent ID recorded).
descriptions.GENERATED: Produced by the SigGen deterministic engine.
descriptions.REMIXED: Remix of an archived output (parent ID recorded).
descriptions.SOURCE_DERIVED: Derived from a filed archive record (source ID recorded).

descriptions.NOT_SIMULATED: No physics/engineering simulation was run (the normal case). 'Concept simulation' on the site means deterministic concept generation, not a physics sim.
descriptions.SIMULATED: A simulation was actually run; method, assumptions, version, inputs, outputs, and limitations are recorded.

descriptions.PARTIAL: Record is missing required fields; must not be presented as fully solved.
descriptions.PUBLISHED: VALIDATED plus published to the public archive.
descriptions.SOLVED: Every required field of the family's record is filled (idea, dimensions+units, materials, colors, components, measurements, parts, build steps, cross-references). Does NOT mean engineered, built, tested, or safe.
descriptions.VALIDATED: SOLVED plus passed the automated per-record validation suite.

descriptions.CALCULATED: Value derived by a documented formula from other fields.
descriptions.GENERATED: Value produced by the seeded deterministic generator (the normal case).
descriptions.MEASURED: Value measured from a real prototype/test — requires evidence.
descriptions.SOURCE_DERIVED: Value taken from a cited filed archive record.
descriptions.USER_SUPPLIED: Value supplied by the user (parameter overrides).
